functions.description: Holds or carries something inside it (a vessel, basket, bag, box).
Something to sit or lie on (a seat, bench, bed, mat).
Gives warmth (a hearth, an oven, a warming stone).
Gives light (a lamp, a torch holder).
Makes a sound or music (a drum, a rattle, a flute).
Protects from weather or gives a room (a roof, a hut, a screen).
Is used on other things to change them (cut, dig, scrape, pound).
Closes or covers something (a lid, a door, a stopper).
